qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Commodity price-taker. While Nucor is North America's premier low-cost electric arc furnace (EAF) mini-mill operator with an enviable decentralized culture, steel products (hot-rolled coil, plate, rebar) remain undifferentiated commodities. Pricing is set by global marginal cost dynamics, trade policy/tariffs, and raw material scrap spreads rather than proprietary pricing power. Competitors like Steel Dynamics and modern imports limit durable pricing power above inflation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (REJECT). Commodity price-taker lacking pricing power above inflation across the full business cycle. Downstream gates bypassed per waterfall.
qualitative.evidence: Operating margins oscillate violently with the steel cycle: surging to 25.1-25.4% during the 2021-2022 post-pandemic shortage, then plunging back to 9.7% in 2024 and mid-single digits in 2025 and 2020 (4.96%). Normalized through-the-cycle GAAP ROIC hovers around 8-11%, failing the sustainable 12% hurdle outside windfall peak years. FCF also turned slightly negative in 2025 (-$188M) due to normalized spreads and high capex on structural mill expansions.
